compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Replace merge.strategy grep in merge-to-main.sh with dso.workflow routing, and update the config-driven test.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## File to Modify
plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh

## Current Implementation (lines 37-57)
Reads merge.strategy from config file with grep, defaults to direct, validates to direct|pr.

## New Implementation
1. Replace the "-- Read merge.strategy from config --" block (lines 37-57) with:
   - Call bash "$_SCRIPT_DIR/read-config.sh" dso.workflow to get the workflow value
   - Map: ci-pr → MERGE_STRATEGY=pr; local|missing → MERGE_STRATEGY=direct
   - On read-config.sh error (exit 1) → default to direct (fail-open, same as current missing-config behavior)
   - Remove the "NOTE: merge.strategy not set" and "ERROR: Unknown merge.strategy" messages — replace with a single dso.workflow error message if needed
2. The --resume cross-strategy mismatch check (lines 60-100) still reads MERGE_STRATEGY — keep as-is; MERGE_STRATEGY is set by the new block
3. Remove the comment "# Reads merge.strategy from .claude/dso-config.conf (default: direct)." from line 3

## MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE
The merge-to-main-pr.sh sets/unsets MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE at lines 2165-2167 as an internal sub-shell signal.
- In merge-to-main.sh: no reference to MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE — no change needed here
- File a follow-up ticket for eliminating MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE from merge-to-main-pr.sh internals (scope: that file is 2184 lines and a separate blast-radius concern)

## Also Update
tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-config-driven.sh — update any tests that set merge.strategy= to use dso.workflow= instead

## Acceptance Criteria
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-config-driven.sh passes with updated dso.workflow config keys
- No reference to merge.strategy remains in merge-to-main.sh
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main.sh still passes (covers the routing behavior)
- File a follow-up bug ticket for MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE elimination in merge-to-main-pr.sh with priority 2
